title: jmri-json-throttle-client-message
description: Data portion of message from client to JMRI for type "throttle"

prefix.description: System prefix of the connection to use for this throttle (e.g. "L" for LocoNet); when absent the default ThrottleManager is used

isLongAddress.description: true if address must be long; false otherwise

rosterEntry.description: ID of RosterEntry for the throttle

speedSteps.description: Number of steps between idle and full throttle

clients.description: Number of clients attempting to control the throttle

name.description: The identity of this throttle used for communications between JMRI server and client

throttle.description: The identity of this throttle used for communications between JMRI server and client; deprecated in favor of "name"

status.description: Cause the JMRI server responds with the complete status of the throttle

release.description: Cause the JMRI server to release the throttle

^F([0-9]|[1-7][0-9]|8[0-4])$.description: true if function on; false otherwise; the highest function available depends on the throttle's connection (F28 for most, F68 for LocoNet and DCC-EX, F84 for TMCC)
